title: R?MJ: The Mystery Hospital
overview:
Summer, 1999. Hajime Oishi comes to a general hospital to visit his best friend, but an explosion rocks the building and releases a deadly pathogen. The hospital is sealed off, trapping everyone inside. Together with his friends and a rookie nurse, Hajime must find a way out before the infection spreads.

This fully voiced horror adventure plays out like an interactive movie. Explore the hospital in first person, choosing to move forward or turn, with pre-rendered scenes carrying you from point to point. Examine your surroundings, pick up items, solve puzzles and call on Hajime's five senses - sight, hearing, touch, smell and taste - at the right moments to push the story forward.

- 1 player
- Memory backup support
